symptom: Fresh isolated r13 crossed PM, CE and Director, then cargo test failed with 7 Rust E0433 diagnostics. QA repair round 1 mutated src/bin/queue_ai.rs and regressed the verifier to 25 diagnostics; rounds 2 and 3 produced no writes. The regressing edit remained on disk.

before.primary_error: fantasy_restaurant_queue_ai::engine unavailable because src/lib.rs declared only pub mod domain

bad_repair.change: replaced external crate imports with local mod engine/path wiring

scratch_probe.lib_root_repair: insert pub mod engine into existing src/lib.rs
scratch_probe.scoped_import_repair: atomically insert use crate::engine::DecisionOutcome inside mod tests and rewrite five rustc-qualified references

root_causes: The Rust lib-root facade source tool could repair re-exports but could not declare an existing disk module when the canonical crate root omitted it.
Rust line-suggestion and trait-import planners split one coupled rustc repair into two independently ineffective halves.
The trait-import planner ignored rustc's nested lexical insertion line and treated repeated identical source lines as unrepairable despite authoritative line numbers and a whole-file before hash.
The outer workspace-quality loop classifies verifier regression but does not yet restore a successful tool effect when post-repair diagnostics worsen.

fixes.scope: one canonical crate plus one existing src/<module>/mod.rs or src/<module>.rs
one transaction containing scoped import and all matching rustc line rewrites

open_followup.requirement: A verifier-regressing repair must be rolled back through Director-owned policy-gated effects; Factory must not write target files directly.
